corrections.reason: The word is መባው ('the offering', matching L23 and L34), where a slight break in the top loop of ባ made it resemble ዛ.
The printed glyph has the shorter right leg of 4th-order ባ in የገባልኝ ('at least my offering has been presented/entered for me').
The printed glyph is 5th-order ሬ with a right-leg ring in አኑሬለሁ ('I have placed it in the hall/vestibule').
